meaning.en: to work, to have an effect (Werk: a work)
meaning.tr: etki etmek, iş görmek (Werk: eser, iş)
meaning.de: tätig sein, eine Folge haben (wirkte, gewirkt; Werk: das Gemachte)

gloss.en: to work, to have an effect; to seem
gloss.de: eine Folge haben; einen Eindruck machen

sentences.tr: Hap on dakika sonra etki ediyor.
sentences.en: The tablet works after ten minutes.
sentences.fr: Le comprimé agit au bout de dix minutes.
sentences.it: La pastiglia fa effetto dopo dieci minuti.
sentences.es: La pastilla hace efecto a los diez minutos.

sentences.en: You seem very calm today.
sentences.fr: Tu sembles très calme aujourd'hui.
sentences.it: Oggi sembri molto tranquillo.
sentences.es: Hoy pareces muy tranquilo.

gloss.de: das, was durch etwas passiert; der Effekt

sentences.en: Coffee has no effect on me.
sentences.fr: Le café ne me fait aucun effet.
sentences.it: Il caffè non mi fa effetto.
sentences.es: El café no me hace efecto.

sentences.en: His words had a strong effect.
sentences.fr: Ses mots ont eu un fort effet.
sentences.it: Le sue parole hanno avuto un forte effetto.
sentences.es: Sus palabras tuvieron un gran efecto.

sentences.tr: İlacın neredeyse hiç yan etkisi yok.
sentences.en: The medicine has hardly any side effects.
sentences.fr: Le médicament n'a presque pas d'effets secondaires.
sentences.it: Il farmaco non ha quasi effetti collaterali.
sentences.es: El medicamento casi no tiene efectos secundarios.

sentences.tr: Yorgunluk sık görülen bir yan etki.
sentences.en: Tiredness is a common side effect.
sentences.fr: La fatigue est un effet secondaire fréquent.
sentences.it: La stanchezza è un effetto collaterale frequente.
sentences.es: El cansancio es un efecto secundario frecuente.

sentences.en: That is a very effective remedy.
sentences.fr: C'est un remède très efficace.
sentences.it: È un rimedio molto efficace.
sentences.es: Es un remedio muy eficaz.

sentences.en: Exercise is effective against stress.
sentences.fr: Le sport est efficace contre le stress.
sentences.it: Lo sport è efficace contro lo stress.
sentences.es: El deporte es eficaz contra el estrés.

sentences.en: The cream was completely ineffective.
sentences.fr: La crème était totalement inefficace.
sentences.it: La crema era del tutto inefficace.
sentences.es: La crema fue totalmente ineficaz.

sentences.en: The contract is invalid.
sentences.fr: Le contrat est nul.
sentences.it: Il contratto non è valido.
sentences.es: El contrato es nulo.

gloss.de: so, wie es ist; tatsächlich; sehr

sentences.en: Is that really true?
sentences.fr: C'est vraiment vrai ?
sentences.it: È davvero vero?
sentences.es: ¿De verdad es cierto?

sentences.en: The food was really good.
sentences.fr: Le repas était vraiment bon.
sentences.it: Il cibo era davvero buono.
sentences.es: La comida estaba muy buena de verdad.

gloss.de: das, was wirklich ist; die Realität

sentences.en: In reality everything is quite different.
sentences.fr: En réalité, tout est très différent.
sentences.it: In realtà è tutto molto diverso.
sentences.es: En realidad todo es muy distinto.

sentences.en: The dream came true.
sentences.fr: Le rêve est devenu réalité.
sentences.it: Il sogno è diventato realtà.
sentences.es: El sueño se hizo realidad.

gloss.en: to realise, to make come true
gloss.de: einen Plan oder Traum wahr machen

sentences.en: She wants to make her dream come true.
sentences.fr: Elle veut réaliser son rêve.
sentences.it: Vuole realizzare il suo sogno.
sentences.es: Quiere hacer realidad su sueño.

sentences.en: The idea is easy to put into practice.
sentences.fr: L'idée est facile à réaliser.
sentences.it: L'idea si può realizzare facilmente.
sentences.es: La idea es fácil de realizar.

sentences.de: Mit kleinen Schritten kann man viel [bewirken].
sentences.en: You can achieve a lot with small steps.
sentences.fr: On peut obtenir beaucoup avec de petits pas.
sentences.it: Con piccoli passi si può ottenere molto.
sentences.es: Con pequeños pasos se puede lograr mucho.

sentences.en: The campaign achieved nothing.
sentences.fr: La campagne n'a rien changé.
sentences.it: La campagna non ha ottenuto nulla.
sentences.es: La campaña no logró nada.

sentences.tr: Birçok öğrenci tiyatro oyununda rol almak istiyor.
sentences.en: Many pupils want to take part in the play.
sentences.fr: Beaucoup d'élèves veulent participer à la pièce.
sentences.it: Molti studenti vogliono partecipare allo spettacolo.
sentences.es: Muchos alumnos quieren participar en la obra.

sentences.de: Alle, die [mitgewirkt] haben, bekommen eine Urkunde.
sentences.tr: Katkıda bulunan herkes bir belge alıyor.
sentences.en: Everyone who took part gets a certificate.
sentences.fr: Tous ceux qui ont participé reçoivent un diplôme.
sentences.it: Tutti quelli che hanno collaborato ricevono un attestato.
sentences.es: Todos los que participaron reciben un diploma.

gloss.en: to affect, to have an effect on
gloss.de: sich auswirken: eine Folge für etwas haben

sentences.de: Wie wird sich das auf die Preise [auswirken]?
sentences.en: How will that affect prices?
sentences.fr: Comment cela va-t-il se répercuter sur les prix ?
sentences.it: Come si ripercuoterà sui prezzi?
sentences.es: ¿Cómo repercutirá eso en los precios?

sentences.de: Schlafmangel kann sich auf die Gesundheit [auswirken].
sentences.en: Lack of sleep can affect your health.
sentences.fr: Le manque de sommeil peut nuire à la santé.
sentences.it: La mancanza di sonno può ripercuotersi sulla salute.
sentences.es: La falta de sueño puede afectar a la salud.

sentences.en: Climate change has big effects.
sentences.fr: Le changement climatique a de grandes répercussions.
sentences.it: Il cambiamento climatico ha grandi effetti.
sentences.es: El cambio climático tiene grandes repercusiones.

sentences.tr: Bunun bize nasıl bir etkisi var?
sentences.en: What impact does that have on us?
sentences.fr: Quel effet cela a-t-il sur nous ?
sentences.it: Che effetto ha su di noi?
sentences.es: ¿Qué efecto tiene eso en nosotros?

gloss.de: etwas, das jemand geschaffen hat; eine Fabrik

sentences.de: Das ist ein frühes [Werk] von Beethoven.
sentences.en: That is an early work by Beethoven.
sentences.fr: C'est une œuvre de jeunesse de Beethoven.
sentences.it: È un'opera giovanile di Beethoven.
sentences.es: Es una obra temprana de Beethoven.

sentences.en: My uncle works at the plant.
sentences.fr: Mon oncle travaille à l'usine.
sentences.it: Mio zio lavora nello stabilimento.
sentences.es: Mi tío trabaja en la fábrica.

gloss.de: ein Gerät zum Arbeiten, z. B. ein Hammer

sentences.en: Have you got the right tool?
sentences.fr: Tu as le bon outil ?
sentences.it: Hai l'attrezzo giusto?
sentences.es: ¿Tienes la herramienta adecuada?

sentences.en: The tools are in the cellar.
sentences.fr: Les outils sont à la cave.
sentences.it: Gli attrezzi sono in cantina.
sentences.es: Las herramientas están en el sótano.
